name: Grade 7 IT Practice: May Week 12 - Presentation
description: Practice words for presenting the maze solution.

words.definition: Sharing work or ideas with others.
words.example: The presentation explained the robot route and code.
The demonstration showed the robot moving through the maze.

words.definition: A way to solve a problem.
words.example: The solution used a sensor to avoid the obstacle.

words.definition: A task that takes effort to complete.
words.example: The biggest challenge was making the turn accurate.

words.definition: What happens at the end of a task or test.
words.example: The final result was a robot that reached the finish line.

words.definition: Thinking about what happened and what you learned.
words.example: The reflection described the strongest test evidence.
